summary: Glass House Brands filed a Form 6-K (material change report) disclosing a deconsolidation transaction to separate its dual-use cannabis business from its medical cannabis business. The company transferred its former dual-use assets into Glass House Retail, LLC (GHR), receiving non-voting, non-participating units that are non-convertible until the NYSE permits cannabis listings. A third-party investor (GHR Investor) holds all voting units, limiting Glass House's control. The move supports a planned NYSE listing application. No deal terms such as price or premium are disclosed. The transaction is structured via an LLC agreement with three unit classes. Key watch item: NYSE rule change on cannabis listing and regulatory approvals for asset transfers.
